term: E (the letter, sounded like the a in Fate)
headwords: E (the letter, sounded like the a in Fate)

english: E (the letter, sounded like the a in Fate)

contexts.text: The speech of the spiritual Angels sounds much from the vowels E and I.
(Words of the spiritual class in the Hebrew Word), and which involve truth, partake of E, and I.
In the Third Heaven... they cannot utter the vowels I, and E, but instead of them Y, and EU. TCR 278.
When the Spiritual Angels speak, their words, which are intellectual ideas, have an affinity with the vowels E, and I; and when they use A (ah), there is something of E, or of AE, in it.
But when a man is speaking with the celestial Angels, he is bent from words in which there is E, and I, to words in which there are A, 0, and U (oo).
The celestial Angels said, as also I have often perceived, that they have not the vowels I, and E...
The Angels of the Third Heaven cannot utter the vowels I, and E, but instead of I they utter Y, or EU; and instead of E they utter EU.
